text: What is the 90 day path to turn the value office concept into operating rhythm?
claudePromptBoundary: Full production prompt is reconstructed from current source template and captured source packet. ai_egress_audit stores prompt hash/snapshot refs, not raw prompt text by default.
claudeResponse:
Lakeshore Holdings — the 90-day path is to prove one Shared Services value office rhythm end-to-end in Treasury and Finance, not to stand up a full multi-function office. Treat the first 90 days as a controlled dress rehearsal: one intake gate, one governed use case per function, one Finance-attested value ledger, one weekly operating cadence.
HR and Legal stay in discovery until Workday, CLM, and matter evidence are loaded. Days 0-30 — establish the spine. Charter the office under the VP Corporate Innovation IT & Data/AI with the Group CIO and CFO as joint sponsors.
Stand up the intake queue in the AI Governance Registry, publish the decision-rights matrix (business owner, control owner, data owner, AI governance), and lock two lighthouse candidates: Kyriba cash/bank connectivity & payment-control proof (Treasurer owns) and Finance close/reconciliation semantic layer (Controller owns).
Baseline capture starts immediately — process volume, cycle time, exception cost, rework — because without a Finance-attested baseline the value ledger is theatre. Days 31-60 — prove the rhythm on one use case. Run the Treasury lighthouse through the full loop: intake → design → control review → build → human-in-the-loop pilot → Finance attestation.
Weekly value council (CIO, CFO delegate, control owner, data owner). Parallel discovery track for HR/Legal — Workday process volumes, CLM/matter taxonomy, policy request patterns — no scale commitments. Days 61-90 — institutionalize. Second lighthouse (Finance close) enters build.
